item.title: AI Regulation in 2026: Navigating an Uncertain Landscape
item.description:
Author: Holistic AI Team
Date: N/A
Tags: ["Artificial Intelligence", "Regulation and Compliance", "AI Governance", "Risk Management", "Technology Policy"]
Summary:
  • AI regulation will be complex and varied by 2026.
  • Organizations must navigate global and local rules carefully.
  • Key frameworks include the EU AI Act and NIST guidelines.
  • Transparency and risk management are critical themes.
  • Proactive AI governance and audits are essential.
  • Collaboration among stakeholders will drive responsible AI innovation.
